data.name: Privacy_Intro
data.value: Nagapie stores your email address and a protected password hash, along with your braindumps, thoughts, drafts, categories, and settings in a SQL database. Your data belongs to your account. Thoughts are not saved in browser storage. Your browser uses a secure session cookie to sign you in.

data.name: Privacy_Ai
data.value: If you agree to automatic sorting, our API sends your text and category names to the configured AI provider. Drafts and saved braindumps are stored with your account in SQL. Content is not kept in application logs; technical request metadata may be logged. You can withdraw AI permission in Settings.

data.name: Privacy_Test
data.value: Before public launch, the operator’s identity, provider retention and training terms, processing region, and log retention must be finalized. This page describes the test build; it is not a completed production privacy notice.

data.name: Terms_Text
data.value: Nagapie helps you capture and organize thoughts. AI suggestions can be wrong; review them before saving. Time buckets do not move automatically, and the app does not send reminders. Keep a separate copy of anything you cannot afford to lose.

data.name: Terms_Test
data.value: This is a test build. Production terms, business details, purchase conditions, and tax information still need to be completed before sales begin.
